summary: A 3D view: one reference each to its scene, camera, lights, display and tools, and an optional title.

kind.doc: The view kind; 3d today, map2d later.

title.doc: The person's own title; absent means one derived from the graph.

scene.doc: What the view shows; shared when a view is added.

camera.doc: Where it looks from; copied when a view is added or duplicated.

lights.doc: How it is lit; shared by default.

display.doc: What the image contains and how it is drawn; shared by default.

tools.doc: Overlays and editing tools; fresh per view.

from: the workspace's views (xfs/view-graph-1) or, when absent, the default one-view graph from preview
migration.how: Each view and node becomes a node; link and unlink become reference and fork.

x-friction.gap: A view of a kind this build doesn't know (a newer build's map2d) must be kept, never drawn, and written back.
x-friction.closes: Nodes of an unknown type or schema kept verbatim and read-only.
